name: TTS Fine-tuning Evaluation
short_description: Evaluate a Kokoro fine-tuned checkpoint on val_96 and filler corpus.
detailed_description: Covers tasks that evaluate a specific Kokoro-82M fine-tuned checkpoint (StyleTTS2 Stage 2) on the held-out val_96 set and the filler corpus. Measures speaker similarity, TTFB, and RTF. Results are compared against the ElevenLabs David baseline and Kokoro base. The task does not run training — it loads a checkpoint and runs inference only.
